subject: Nightcap capacity endorsement for Atlas Retail POC
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlas-retail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Liu <katie.liu@atlas-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nightcap capacity window request for POC - latency/throughput validation

Ben —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. We want to run a controlled peak simulation against the Redwood endpoint to validate our failover logic and P95 latency at scale. Plan is an overnight run (local time) starting 23:00 and lasting ~6 hours (11pm–5am) to simulate end-of-day traffic. Key targets: ~2,200 concurrent RPS bursts, ~1.2M tokens total across the window, P95 latency < 250ms for the streaming endpoint.

As discussed, can Redwood issue a temporary credit/top-up or safety net so we don't hit quota caps mid-run? We're asking for a one-time uplift sufficient for the run — a rough ask is 200k tokens (we'll pay overage if we exceed, but want an initial buffer) and a 24–48h trial extension on the sandbox so our telemetry can persist for post-run analysis.

Attached is our preflight runbook (preflight_plan_v2.pdf) and a short telemetry spec. If procurement needs an official PO or a short signature, loop them in — procurement@atlas-retail.com is copied. Happy to provide more detail on QPS cadence.

Appreciate the help — this run will determine our cutover timing.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, Atlas Retail
Samir.Patel@atlas-retail.com
Attachment: preflight_plan_v2.pdf (PDF, 98KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlas-retail.com>
Cc: Katie Liu <katie.liu@atlas-retail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nightcap capacity window request for POC - latency/throughput validation

Samir —

Thanks for the details and the runbook. This is doable; appreciate the concrete targets. Quick mutual action plan so we're aligned: 

- Redwood provides an ephemeral credit uplift (options below) and enables a 48h sandbox window so telemetry stays available for analysis.
- Atlas runs the 23:00–05:00 simulation; Redwood SRE will monitor token burn and 95th percentile latency.
- Post-run we’ll sync on logs/metrics and decide on a reserved capacity path if results look good.

Credit options I can authorize quickly: 
- Option A (recommended): 250k token ephemeral credit, active for 48 hours from time of application.
- Option B: 150k token credit + a follow-up top-up on request (faster to approve, smaller initial risk).

Please confirm which you prefer. Also, Karthik is copied to stand up on-call during the run and instrument the latency traces. Marissa, can you sign off on a one-time uplift under the standard POC playbook? I’ll prep the HubSpot note and HubSpot deal RDW-DEAL-2027-ATLAS-0891.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nightcap capacity window request for POC - latency/throughput validation

Ben / team —

Approve Option A (250k ephemeral tokens, 48h window) with the following conditions: 

1) Redwood SRE must monitor token burn and escalate if usage exceeds 80% of uplift.
2) Atlas must sign the one-page POC addendum (we can use DocuSign link) by start time; procurement copied on original request.
3) Marketing and Sales to log outcome and flag any quality regressions in the post-run eval doc (HubSpot deal + shared Drive).

Ben, apply the uplift tomorrow morning so Atlas has the headroom for their overnight run. Karthik — please be on-call during the window; Vivek, please confirm we've applied the proper quota profile in the console. I attached the approval snippet for Atlas' records.

Thanks — won’t be a full contractual change, just a one-off safety net tied to the POC.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: approval_snippet.png (PNG, 12KB)

Good news: Marissa approved Option A. I’ve applied a 250,000 token ephemeral uplift to the Atlas Retail sandbox and extended the sandbox telemetry window to 48 hours starting when the uplift is activated. You should see the quota change reflected in the console within the next 10 minutes. 

What I did / links: 
- Applied 250k ephemeral credit (ID: uplift-2027-ATLAS-0891) — expires 48h after activation.
- HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/93124 (RDW-DEAL-2027-ATLAS-0891).
- DocuSign POC addendum sent to procurement@atlas-retail.com: https://docusign.com/records/abc123

Karthik will be on-call for the run and Vivek confirmed the quota profile is set to the streaming-optimized path. If you hit >80% consumption, Redwood SRE will proactively message you and we’ll hold brief checkpoints. After the run please send the post-run eval and we’ll schedule a 30-minute readout.

Attached the Atlas mutual action plan (MAP) we discussed. Good luck — let us know when you kick off and we’ll watch the telemetry.

—Ben
